messages:
Maria T.: quick sync — we need a concrete checklist for the next catalog cohort: QA bench thresholds + legal/comms artifacts before we flip the onboard flag. timeline: next Wed. who owns what?
AJ: I can own the QA bench side. propose: acceptance if regression <= 2% on our core LLM slices and embedding drift < 0.03 cosine on 10k sample. p95 latency under 380ms. cost delta < 8%.
Kevin L.: sounds reasonable. can we define the slices? i suggest: short prompts (<=50 tok), long prompts (>=1024 tok), completion safety probes, and l10n edge-cases. also add a small readonly customer workload replay.
Rashmi: for the replay we need a sanitized sample. legal: will require provenance proof for any customer data used in replay. @Sophie (Legal) can you confirm what proof you need?
Sophie (Legal): yes — for any replayed customer workload we need: 1) documented consent or contract clause, 2) hashing + salt audit trail, 3) data lineage ticket linked to the onboard PR. if it's synthetic or public benchmark, note it in the artifact.
AJ: thanks. so we should separate 'bench artifacts' into: bench results (csv/json + summary), replay manifest (if used), provenance doc, and a short comms blurb for customers.
Maria T.: comms blurb = customer-facing note in the catalog entry outlining any breaking changes, expected perf/cost delta, and recommended migration steps. ops needs a runbook for rollback. @ops-bot can you confirm runbook template?
ops-bot: runbook template: 1) immediate rollback patch (pin to previous model version); 2) automated traffic drain to canary; 3) ingested alert thresholds (error rate > 2% OR latency p95 > 600ms OR quality-regression > 5%); 4) post-rollback postmortem checklist.
Kevin L.: adding canary plan: 1% traffic 1h -> 5% 6h -> 25% 24h -> 100% if green. small cohorts opt-in path. document canary metrics and owners.
Rashmi: legal also flagged licensing metadata for each model binary. we need a short manifest field in the catalog entry: license, weights provenance, allowed commercial use yes/no. Sophie any short verbiage?
Sophie (Legal): use this template: "weights_provenance: [source], license: [SPDX tag], known_restrictions: [text], legal_contact: [name/email]." that should cover quick triage.
AJ: putting a little script here to run the bench locally:
```
python infra/bench.py --model version-XYZ --slices short,long,safety --replay-file samples/replay-manifest.json --output results/version-XYZ-bench.json
```
Maria T.: great. final asks: 1) AJ will publish bench artifacts and summary PR by Tue EOD. 2) Sophie will sign off on provenance/license fields by Tue noon. 3) Ops will attach runbook to the onboard PR. 4) Kevin will own canary gates and tag the cohort.
Kevin L.: ack. i'll also add a tiny smoke-check for semantic quality (exact-match/intent score) so we can detect catastrophic regressions fast. threshold: intent-score drop > 4% triggers rollback.
Rashmi: we should also prepare the customer comms snippet. i'll draft and ping product_comms. include who to contact for migration help and optional opts (pin gracepath for 30 days).
Maria T.: thanks — i'll open the catalog-onboard PR and link JIRA CAT-4482 and include all artifacts. putting the checklist in the PR description so QA/legal/ops can ack.
AJ: will run bench and upload to the PR.
Sophie (Legal): will review provenance + license fields and leave a comment on PR.
ops-bot: canary created for version-XYZ at 2026-03-11T10:15Z — monitoring hook attached. :eyes:
Maria T.: awesome, if we hit these gates we can flip onboard flag next Wed. any objections?
Kevin L.: none from me.
Rashmi: fine by me.
Sophie (Legal): no objections pending the provenance doc.
Maria T.: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short checklist in the PR and ping when it's ready. :thumbsup:
